title: File:Hermann Hammerl Universität Innsbruck.jpg
desc:
Hermann Hammerl (1853–1933) was a Tyrolean experimental physicist and secondary school teacher. He studied maths, physics and chemistry at the University of Innsbruck and was later appointed professor there. He was also a teacher at the Ober-Realschule, today Bundesrealgymnasium, in Innsbruck.

title: File:Paul Czermak Universität Innsbruck.jpg
desc:
Paul Czermak (1857–1912) was an Austrian physicist. He studied in Graz, Prague, Vienna and Strasbourg. He was appointed professor of cosmic physics and meteorology at the University of Graz. He also taught at the University of Innsbruck.

title: File:Karl Exner Universität Innsbruck.jpg
desc:
Karl Exner (1842–1914) was an Austrian mathematician and physicist. He completed his studies in Vienna, Zurich and Freiburg. He was appointed professor of mathematical physics at the University of Innsbruck in 1894.
